item.title: MILLIANS: When the Bacons were kings
item.description: Late in the 1960s, Nat Bacon knew his Chevrolet dealership needed a new home.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Support for library fair a support for literacy
item.description: Next weekend, the annual Friends of the Mary Vinson Memorial Library book sale will be held at the Baldwin County Recreation Department on Highway 22.

item.title: Milledgeville man arrested for truck theft, chase
item.description: A 40-year-old Milledgeville man is in trouble with the law after he was caught driving a stolen truck and then getting involved in a chase with local authorities.

item.title: Georgia College online master’s programs ranked among best in the South by U.S. News & World Report
item.description: Georgia College & State University’s online master’s degree programs have again been ranked among the nation’s best, earning four top-five designations among all regional universities in the South, according to U.S. News & World Report’s 2026 rankings, released today.

item.title: GCSU’s Walker named GEAC conference co-chair
item.description: The Georgia Education Advancement Council’s Board of Directors recently named its 2026 officers and welcomed new board members to support the organization’s mission of advancing higher education advancement professionals across Georgia.

item.title: Baldwin Co. firefighters battle 2 house fires hours apart
item.description: Two homes were damaged earlier this week by fires in Baldwin County, local authorities say.

item.title: Milledgeville City Council adopts resolution to prevent new convenience stores, food marts, vape shops
item.description: A moratorium preventing new convenience stores, food marts and vape shops from opening such businesses in Milledgeville has been extended another four months.

item.title: Snow in Baldwin, surrounding counties will make driving hazardous
item.description: Strong, gusty winds coupled with below freezing temperatures and an expected several inches of snow will make driving extremely dangerous this weekend throughout Baldwin County.

item.title: Atrium raises staff starting rate minimum wage
item.description: Atrium Health Navicent is making a significant additional investment into its local workforce, announcing an increase in the minimum starting rate wage for eligible teammates in Georgia to $18.85 per hour, which will be reflected on the teammates’ Jan. 30 paychecks.

item.title: Bunn’s Bulldogs on quest for state repeat, national bid
item.description: Ashley Bunn and the Georgia Military College softball Bulldogs returned to the top of the Georgia Collegiate Athletic Conference in 2025, celebrating their first tournament championship since 2022.
